defect: The default python3 interpreter is /usr/local/bin/python3, but DuckDB is installed only for /usr/bin/python3; installing DuckDB into the default interpreter obtains a newer storage format incompatible with the grader's pinned DuckDB.
evidence: environment/Dockerfile PATH order conflicts with its own installed package location; attempt-01.jsonl turn 9 shows the missing import and its verifier reports database version 999, as do 9 other attempts.
change: Put /usr/bin before /usr/local/bin in PATH so python3 uses the preinstalled DuckDB-compatible interpreter.

defect: The top-products checker requires an integer lexical spelling even though the instruction requires a numeric total quantity and valid CSV writers may serialize an integral aggregate as 19.0.
evidence: tests/test_outputs.py parses total_quantity with int(); attempt-02.jsonl and attempt-09.jsonl verifier diagnostics show all other checks pass and only int('19.0') fails.
change: Parse total_quantity numerically, require integral values, and retain the descending-order and expected-content checks.
